take: Kaynes Technology continues to deliver top-line growth backed by a large order book, but working capital pressures and negative operating cash flows remain critical drags. Profitability has lagged revenue expansion due to operational constraints in segments like smart metering and elevated debtor days.

promises.promise: Expecting net working capital days between 70 to 85 days.
promises.delivered: Working capital days reached 193 days by March 2026.

promises.promise: Targeting INR450 to INR500 crores full year revenue between OSAT and PCB.
Rail business to grow by around 20% to 25% this year.
Do a PCB revenue of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
Do an OSAT revenue of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
Aiming to achieve USD 1 billion in revenue by FY28.

narrative.claim: Core EMS business is driving strong year-on-year revenue expansion.
narrative.numbers: Consolidated revenue grew 40.6% YoY to INR946 crores in Jun 2026.

narrative.claim: Working capital will normalize and improve via supply chain management.
narrative.numbers: Debtor days surged to 154 and cash conversion cycle lengthened to 193 days in FY26.

narrative.claim: Consolidated cash flows are dragged down primarily by the newly acquired smart metering business.
narrative.numbers: CFO was negative INR600 crores in FY26 while cash conversion 5-year average is negative 63%.

guidance.latest: INR450 to INR500 crores full year revenue
Outgrow the market and double market growth rate
USD 1 billion in revenue by FY28

bull.point: Consolidated annual revenue expanded consistently from INR706 crores in FY22 to INR3,626 crores in FY26.
Commercial production for OSAT has commenced with sample shipments dispatched to three separate clients.
Order book stood at a robust INR83,663 Mn as of March 31, 2026, supporting visibility.

bear.point: Operating cash flow turned deeply negative to negative INR600 crores for FY26.
Debtor days nearly doubled from 77 days in FY25 to 154 days in FY26.
Profit after tax for Jun 2026 dropped 25.3% YoY to INR56 crores despite top-line growth of 40.6%.

watch: Smart metering business monetization or divestment updates
Cash conversion cycle and debtor days trajectory
OSAT and PCB commercial revenue delivery against targets
